title: Jungle Expedition

reviewPolicy.reason: Player visual judgment remains authoritative. Pass 10 materially improves the grounded lost-city river and all five landmark portraits, but does not self-certify the active 10/10 Island 018 goal.

focusedLandmarkObserved.notes: All five L3 portrait presets were inspected after the camera-authoring correction; six retained screenshots include the temple and four satellite landmarks plus the final overview.

viteProductionBuild.notes: Existing mixed static/dynamic import and large chunk warnings remain; the build completed successfully.

knownCaptureNotes: Every pass-10 visual is procedural Three.js geometry, instancing, vertex colour, light, or an in-memory generated texture; no 2D scenery image was introduced.
